integrity: Complete standalone derivation, deterministic standard-library checker and recorded check output are included; exact fractions and numerical checks are finite adjuncts to proof.
scientific_limitations: Gaussian smoothing of centered positive Gamma-jump compound-Poisson laws only. Fixed-shape asymptotics; no general-jump classification or independent validation. Previously known general variational and pure-jump identities explicitly credited.
title: Sharp Gaussian-dilution transition for optimal sub-gamma scales of Gamma-jump compound Poisson laws
